I'm no physicist, so my math could be way off, but I calculate acceleration/deceleration to be at least 439.375m/s² (more if you ever reach a cruising speed). That's a constant 44.8 Gs for four minutes. That's definitely enough to make you black out, and for that length of time, you're pretty likely to be DOA, but I don't think you'd have your guts blown out your anus unless you were bent over for it (a 4lb large intestine @ 44.8 Gs would weigh in at 180lbs, but in a car seat, it'd mostly be pushing against your back, not your ass).
